## History

Oliver Sloane does not explicitly participate in the recorded events of this volume, though he is part of the broader [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community during a period when the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) forms and undertakes local projects. During this time, the society manages hall repairs and navigates a painting mishap, ultimately gaining public support despite a disastrous paint job. Additionally, the society's members successfully prevent [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) from using his fences for painted medicine advertisements.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P36](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0036), [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), +9 more_
